description: Istanbul Airport, Turkiye. ARP, elevation and magnetic variation are from Turkiye's own AIP (DHMI), AD 2.2 'Aerodrome geographical and administrative data' -- current AIRAC cycle, downloaded and read directly this session (https://www.dhmi.gov.tr/AIPDocuments/LT_AD_2_LTFM_en.pdf). This is the best-sourced pack in the project: a national AIP, not a VATSIM/IVAO simulation document. weatherStation assumes LTFM reports its own METAR; not separately confirmed. trafficAreaNm, groundMaxSpeedKt, groundAltitudeMarginFt and arrivalSpeedFloorKt are carried over unchanged from the other packs. See docs/LTFM_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md for full sourcing and confidence notes.
